meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描你的代码库,按功能分组画 Mermaid 流程图,找出重复实现的逻辑,提出统一架构方案,并生成可直接复制给 /make-plan 的交接提示词。它不写实现代码,产物放在 PATHFINDER-<日期>/ 目录下。
howto.when: 当你要求「find the ideal path」、统一重复的系统,或重构前审计架构时触发。它会先做功能发现并等你确认边界,再逐功能展开画图。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 梳理这个仓库的功能流程图
say.note: 先做功能发现,确认边界后再展开

say.text: 找出多个功能里重复实现的逻辑,给我统一方案
say.note: 输出重复报告与统一流程图

say.text: 为统一后的每个系统生成 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps your codebase into per-feature Mermaid flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, proposes a unified architecture, and writes copy-paste /make-plan prompts. It writes no implementation code; artifacts go in PATHFINDER-<date>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It runs feature discovery and waits for boundary approval before fanning out.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to map this repo's feature flowcharts
say_en.note: Runs feature discovery, then fans out after approval

say_en.text: Find logic duplicated across features and propose a unified design
say_en.note: Emits a duplication report and unified flowchart

say_en.text: Generate /make-plan prompts for each unified system
